<module id="div_16bit">
    <description>Divides a 16-bit dividend by an 8-bit divisor, producing a 16-bit quotient and a 16-bit remainder.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="A" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit dividend.</input>
        <input id="B" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit divisor.</input>
        <output id="result" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit quotient.</output>
        <output id="odd" width_description="[15:0]">16-bit remainder.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        // Register declarations for storing inputs
        reg [15:0] a_reg;
        reg [7:0] b_reg;
        
        // Always block triggered by changes in inputs A and B
        always @(A or B) begin
            // Update register values based on current inputs
            a_reg <= A;
            b_reg <= B;
            
            // Initialize variables for comparison and shifting
            integer i = 0;
            reg [15:0] temp_result = 0;
            reg [15:0] temp_odd = 0;
            reg [15:0] temp_remainder = 0;
            
            // Perform division operation
            for(i = 15; i >= 8; i = i - 1) begin
                // Check if the extracted bits of the dividend are greater than the divisor
                if(a_reg[i -: 8] > b_reg) begin
                    // Set the corresponding bit of the quotient to 1
                    temp_result[i] = 1;
                    
                    // Calculate the remainder by subtracting the divisor from the extracted bits
                    temp_remainder = a_reg[i -: 8] - b_reg;
                    
                    // Shift the remainder left by 1 bit
                    temp_odd = {temp_remainder[14:0], a_reg[i - 1]};
                end else begin
                    // Set the corresponding bit of the quotient to 0
                    temp_result[i] = 0;
                    
                    // Shift the dividend left by 1 bit
                    temp_odd = {a_reg[i - 1], a_reg[i - 2:0]};
                end
                
                // Assign the updated quotient and remainder to the output ports
                $display("i=%d, a_reg=%d, b_reg=%d, temp_result=%d, temp_odd=%d", i, a_reg, b_reg, temp_result, temp_odd);
                
                // Update the dividend for the next iteration
                a_reg = temp_odd;
            end
            
            // Assign final results to output ports
            $display("Final result: %d, Final odd: %d", temp_result, temp_odd);
            $display("Final a_reg: %d, Final b_reg: %d", a_reg, b_reg);
            $display("Final i: %d", i);
            $display("Final temp_result: %d, Final temp_odd: %d", temp_result, temp_odd);
